columns.name: Photo
columns.description: photo(s) of the unidentified decedent's face, body, clothing, or property; photos of the face or body include a graphic image warning before displaying

columns.name: Photo 2
columns.description: photo(s) of the unidentified decedent's face, body, clothing, or property; photos of the face or body include a graphic image warning before displaying

columns.name: Sketch
columns.description: sketch of the unidentified decedent's face or clothing/property

columns.name: Case Number
columns.description: case number generated by the Medical Examiner's Office used to uniquely identify a decedent

columns.name: Date Found
columns.description: date the decedent was found deceased

columns.name: Sex
columns.description: sex of the decedent as determined by the Medical Examiner

columns.name: Race
columns.description: suspected race of the decedent as determined by the Medical Examiner

columns.name: Age Range
columns.description: suspected age range of the decedent at the time of death as determined by the Medical Examiner

columns.name: Location Found Details
columns.description: details of the location where the decedent was found, including address where available

columns.name: Physical Description
columns.description: decedent's physical features where available, including height, weight, hair/eye color, scars, tattoos, and other identifiable characteristics

columns.name: Clothing
columns.description: description of the clothing found on the decedent, including brand and size where available

columns.name: Property
columns.description: description of additional non-clothing property found with the decedent, including jewelry
